result.summary: The user interface is generally well-structured but contains some minor visual inconsistencies and placeholder content that detract from a finished look.

issues.description: Generic vector illustrations are used in place of actual food photography, making the app look incomplete.
issues.suggestion: Populate restaurant listings with high-quality, authentic food images.

issues.description: Thumbnail backgrounds in the 'Fastest near you' section have inconsistent colors (grey, dark, and brown).
issues.suggestion: Standardize the background colors for all restaurant thumbnail containers.

issues.description: Badge styles are inconsistent; time estimates use solid pill shapes while promo badges have borders.
issues.suggestion: Unify badge designs across different categories for a more cohesive UI.
